methodology.timing: Fresh foreground target per trial; real RAF callback scripting, dispatch and explicit flush/mount-dispose durations. Warmup excluded. Native probes, hashing, UI verification and output outside clean timing; replay includes import/preflight/run/hash/disposal. Diagnostics variant captures bounded public instrumentation during work. No native prototype hooks or forced GC in timing.
methodology.reference: Benchmark-only eager structuredClone/freeze state and full-view DOM scan with retained keyed elements, one delegated listener. Same fixture actions, pixels/order/keyed identity and endpoint hashes; fewer general guards/anchors/lifecycle features than runtime. Not another frontend framework.
methodology.probes: Separate un-timed native method/setter hooks count successful tree/text/attribute/style writes; verify diagnostics against native calls, exact independent/burst text writes and retained key identity. Counter hooks restored on failure.
methodology.frames: Native timestamp intervals are between captured RAF callbacks, not total frame/paint/input latency, refresh rate or tracing-based scripting budgets.
methodology.memory: Separate fresh target per profile after timing. CDP heap usage and DOM/listener counters include harness/modules/JIT/renderer overhead. Forced-GC CDP round trips separately labeled, not GC pause duration. Natural browser GC pause API is not collected (null); heap samples are not allocated bytes/true peak/leak proof.
methodology.ordering: Rotate variants by round, sequential cases. One isolated Chrome process/profile per campaign. Do not run other tests/benchmarks concurrently.
